title: SEED evidence kernel
description: The evidence contract of this repository as one machine-readable object: the four record types that scripts/onboard_check.py validates. Every record is a Markdown file under workflow/; the human form is workflow/templates/<TYPE>.md. A record's type is the directory it lives in. The `records` object below maps each directory to the schema every file in it must satisfy.

records.description: Directory -> schema. Every *.md file directly under the directory is one record of that type.

vocabularies.description: The closed vocabularies, restated so a reviewer can read them without opening each schema. They are identical to the enums in the record schemas and to the constants in scripts/onboard_check.py.
